page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c2.large is a compute-optimized virtual machine instance belonging to the ecs.c2 server family. Built on the x86_64 CPU architecture and managed via the KVM hypervisor, this instance features 16 dedicated vCPUs and 32.0 GB of system memory. This configuration establishes a 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, providing 2.0 GB of memory per core.

The ecs.c2.large instance does not include local NVMe or SSD storage, requiring reliance on external block storage volumes for persistent data. It does not feature any integrated graphics processing units or complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the dedicated CPU allocation ensures predictable compute performance without resource contention, making it suitable for compute-bound workloads. The low memory-to-CPU ratio makes it a cost-effective choice for tasks that require significant processing power but have modest memory footprints. Appropriate workloads include batch processing, web serving, distributed analytics, and compute-intensive application servers.
